{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk-blend blouse, relaxed tailored fit, hip length, ivory (#F2EBDD), matte crepe with a soft drape

Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full ankle length, charcoal grey (#3B3F45), fine wool-blend twill

Textured blazer, single-breasted, slightly relaxed cut, hip length, camel-and-oat tweed (#B89B72), wool bouclé

Leather loafers, almond toe, low block heel, deep chocolate brown (#4A3328), smooth calf leather

Leather belt, slim, brushed gold buckle, cognac (#9A5B32), smooth leather

Structured tote bag, medium size, top handles, cognac (#9A5B32), grained leather

Small hoop earrings, thin, gold (#C9A24B), polished metal

Wool-blend scarf, lightweight, draped loosely at the neck, sage green (#8A9A7B), soft brushed wool

This outfit sits right in the neat business-casual range: a blouse with tailored trousers, a textured jacket and loafers look polished without feeling stiff. The warm camel tweed, ivory and charcoal make a calm autumn palette, and the sage scarf adds a fresh accent near the face. The straight trousers and relaxed blazer give an elongated, balanced line, and the soft fabrics stay comfortable through a full day at the desk. The cognac belt and bag tie in with the brown loafers, so the whole look feels pulled together."}
